Subject: Scheduling: Dedicated/private demo - regional security reviewers (EU/APAC)

Jordan — thanks again for the time earlier. As discussed, we want to run a short walkthrough of a Dedicated/private deployment setup for Orbital Health and include your regional security reviewers (EU DPO + APAC security lead) so they can validate data residency, audit logs, and KMS integrations.

Quick ask: can you confirm whether Sven (EU DPO) and Amiya (APAC security) can join one of the following slots? I've put timezone conversions in parens — please pick one or suggest alternatives that work for your reviewers.

Option A — Wed Jun 23 10:00 PT / Wed Jun 23 19:00 CET / Thu Jun 24 02:00 SGT (long day for APAC)
Option B — Wed Jun 23 08:00 PT / Wed Jun 23 17:00 CET / Thu Jun 24 00:00 SGT (earlier for APAC)
Option C — Tue Jun 22 16:00 PT / Wed Jun 23 01:00 CET / Wed Jun 23 09:00 SGT (APAC-friendly)

Note: I realize daylight-savings can make the labels confusing — Monica, can you please ensure the calendar invites are sent with explicit timezone offsets so booking systems don't shift times?

Proposed agenda (30–45m):
- 10m: Deployment topology & network controls
- 10m: Data residency, retention, and audit logs
- 10m: Key management (KMS/HSM) and access controls
- 5m: Q&A / next steps

If the EU/ APAC reviewers prefer a 20–30 minute security-only pre-call, we can schedule that 30 minutes before the demo.

Thanks — Rishi

- Amiya is traveling early next week but can do an early SGT time on Wed/Thu if we lock it now.

From my side, Options B and C look most promising; Option A will likely be too late for Amiya. Can you/Monica propose one firm slot and we'll confirm availability? We may also need to involve procurement for a quick T&Cs check — cc'ing Claire.

- Priyom: can you prepare a 1-pager on audit logging and KMS flows that we can attach? (short bullet list is fine).

Cheers,
Rishi

Subject: Re: Scheduling: Dedicated/private demo - regional security reviewers (EU/APAC)

Rishi / Jordan — thanks for the options. I can make windows on Wed 23 June in the morning (09:00–11:30 CEST) but I have a full-day audit on Tue 22 so Option 3 will not work for me.

Please note the items I'd like included in the agenda for the reviewers:
- Data residency model (does Redwood host any persistent PII outside customer's VPC in Dedicated?)
- Audit log retention, searchability, and export (format + retention policy)
- KMS integration: what key rotation and HSM options are available; are there any managed-key fallbacks?
- Access controls: who has access to runtime logs and the control plane (RBAC model)

Attachment: SOC2-summary.pdf (redacted SOC 2 scope summary) — please review before the call.

Also, we've had calendar invites from other vendors that shifted by an hour because of timezone settings in the calendar client. Monica, please ensure the invite includes the UTC offset in the title or description so our calendar admin doesn't accidentally reschedule.

Best,
Sven Müller
Data Protection Officer | Orbital Health
